verdict.rationale: The evidence shows pre-filled MCP config blocks only for desktop and IDE clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code), plus a REST directory API with generic cURL, JavaScript, Python and PHP samples. Neither is a documented adapter for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. A standard MCP Gateway endpoint is at most a building block a developer could wire up themselves, not a documented framework integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
